message: Six setup attempts stopped before an HTTP inference request: missing PaddleX OCR extras; zero-byte/corrupt SciPy; missing package metadata for regex/safetensors/sentencepiece; missing GenAI client extra; zero-byte/corrupt OpenCV; and zero-byte/corrupt sniffio.
remediation: Installed version-matched paddlex[ocr,genai-client]==3.7.2 requirements and repaired the affected pinned packages in the dedicated V3 serving environment. Pipeline construction then passed and the subsequent frozen evaluation completed.
